sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI announced the $2 input and $10 output price for the Grok-2 and Grok-2 Vision dated models; it does not specify a cache-write price or an effective date.

sources.quote: All prices are in USD. For per-model details, see the models page.
sources.supports: Current official API pricing page; it has no Grok-2-vision listing and cannot establish the historical cache-write price or timing.

notes: The xAI announcement supports the $2 input and $10 output prices, but says nothing about cache-write billing. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint was temporarily offline during research, so no snapshot pair was available; the evidence cannot determine whether cache_write=10 was an official price or a models.dev field error, or date any change.
